hook.line: The letter from the bank has arrived and there is no clever way out. Spanish has a sentence for when life leaves you exactly one door.
hook.es: No me quedó más remedio que cerrar el café el domingo.
hook.en: I had no choice but to close the café on Sunday.

examples.es: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar el viaje.
examples.en: We had no choice but to cancel the trip.

examples.es: No le quedó otra opción que renunciar.
examples.en: She had no option but to resign.

examples.es: No me quedó más remedio que vender el carro.
examples.en: I had no choice but to sell the car.

examples.es: No queda de otra que esperar.
examples.en: There's nothing for it but to wait.

rule:
When there is no alternative, Spanish says the options did not remain for you.

*No me quedó más remedio que* + infinitive. The *me / te / le / nos / les* is the person. *Remedio* stays singular. *Otra opción* works too.

*No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar el viaje.*

Short and general: *No hay más remedio.* In Latin America, *No queda de otra* and *No me queda de otra* are very common.

Watch out: *remedio* is not only medicine.
smallPrint: Teachers call this an impersonal expression with an indirect object: the person is the one the choice is left to.

readAndPick.es: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar el viaje.
options: We had no choice but to cancel the trip.
We chose to cancel the trip.
We refused to cancel the trip.
There's no more medicine.
There's no other choice.
There's another way.

readAndPick.es: No le quedó otra opción que renunciar.
options: She wanted to resign.
She had another option besides resigning.
She had no option but to resign.
I have no other choice.
I have nothing left over.
I don't mind either way.

readAndPick.es: No me quedó más remedio que vender el carro.
options: I decided to sell the car happily.
I had no choice but to sell the car.
I had no car left to sell.

readAndPick.es: No queda de otra que esperar.
options: Nobody is waiting.
There's no need to wait.
There's nothing for it but to wait.

readAndPick.es: No les quedó más remedio que irse.
options: They had no choice but to leave.
They preferred to leave.
They had nothing left to leave.

readAndPick.es: No había más remedio que aceptar la oferta.
options: There was a choice, and we accepted the offer.
There was no choice but to accept the offer.
There was no offer to accept.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *quedó* or *quedaron*: No nos ___ más remedio que cancelar el viaje. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar el viaje.
yourTurn.why: *Remedio* is singular, so the verb is *quedó*.

yourTurn.prompt: Talking about yourself. Choose *me* or *le*: No ___ quedó otra opción que renunciar. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: No me quedó otra opción que renunciar.
yourTurn.why: The choice was left to *me*, so *me quedó*.
*No hay* + *más remedio* says there is no way out.

yourTurn.prompt: We had no choice but to cancel the trip.
yourTurn.answer: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar el viaje.
yourTurn.why: *Nos* is the person, and *que* leads into the infinitive.
*No me queda de otra* is the everyday way to say it.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about her: *No me quedó más remedio que renunciar.*
yourTurn.answer: No le quedó más remedio que renunciar.
accept: No le quedó otra opción que renunciar.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about them: *No me quedó más remedio que vender el carro.*
yourTurn.answer: No les quedó más remedio que vender el carro.
yourTurn.why: *Me* becomes *les* for them, and *remedio* stays singular.

pitfalls.wrong: No me quedó más remedio de cancelar.
pitfalls.right: No me quedó más remedio que cancelar.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The link to the infinitive is *que*, not *de*.

pitfalls.wrong: No nos quedaron más remedio que cancelar.
pitfalls.right: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Remedio* is singular, so the verb is *quedó*.

pitfalls.wrong: Nos no quedó más remedio que cancelar.
pitfalls.right: No nos quedó más remedio que cancelar.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *No* comes first, then the pronoun: *no nos quedó*.

personal: Tell us about a time you had no choice: *No me quedó más remedio que…*.
